## Task and requirements

Issue IDs, milestone and relevant FR/QA IDs.

## Change

What behavior changed; files/contracts/content revisions affected; scope intentionally excluded.

## Evidence

Exact commands/results; build and content SHA; actual UI screenshots/traces; device/browser inventory where tested.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Core rules, schemas, fixtures and documentation agree.
- [ ] Tests are real and failures/skips are reported.
- [ ] Robot parity and accessible input are preserved where affected.
- [ ] No unapproved network collection, dependency telemetry or external action.
- [ ] Human/device/legal/research gates are not claimed without evidence.
